title: Compute Services
description: Learn EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Beanstalk, Batch, and Lightsail. Understand instance types, AMIs, security groups, and EBS.
longDescription: Compute is where you run your applications. In this module, you will learn about Amazon EC2, the foundational compute service, and how to choose instance types, configure security groups, and attach storage. You will also explore Auto Scaling, Elastic Beanstalk, Batch, and Lightsail to understand which service is right for each workload.
whatYouLearn: Launch EC2 instances with the right instance type
Configure security groups and key pairs
Compare EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, Batch, and Lightsail
